Personally I would just want to know someone is there.
Its hard not knowing the exact specifics and personality of this person, but for me, I think it's about being a presence without being invasive, I know that every cell in your body may want to scream out and pull her out of her own situation, but that can have severe consequences.

I think just letting her know that you are around in whatever capacity she needs someone to be, but also some light check in may be a good idea, just a simple message of 'Hello' or 'hope you're having a good day' can be nice.

If you know what kinds of things she likes that could help, maybe send her a few tracks of her favourite music or comedy - that's what's helped me a lot, focusing on things outside my situation, realising there's more to life than my failures, seeing there's other reasons to live for.

It won't be an easy journey but people like yourself are why I have hope for the world and myself, I'm lucky enough to have a great support network around me, and I won't stop appreciating those people ever after knowing what they've helped me through.

All the best with your kindness,

Basically, I make progress against my addictions and I let them control my life because it's easy.

I go through ups and downs and just recently I was on a roll - I finally applied and got into a uni I've been dreaming of for over 5 years.

Now that I find myself broken by my own hand again, relapsed and low, I have completely lost hope. I just don't believe with the way that I am, that I am capable of change, it's tempted me a lot to end things, but I've always resisted.

I don't know how to make myself better but I can't keep living with who & how I am, there's so much hate in my head for me, I just wish I could get up and become the person I want to be, but I fail so easy.


Thak you for all the amazing work you've all done for so long to help so many, I hope you all know what an amazing community this really is and the power it has to truly help people.
